entities.name: APN aggregate maximum bit rate
entities.description: Information element indicating the aggregate maximum bit rate for an APN in both downlink and uplink directions. It has variable length (4, 6, or 8 octets) with optional extended fields for higher bit rates.

entities.name: EPS quality of service
entities.description: Information element specifying QoS parameters for EPS bearers including QCI, maximum bit rates, and guaranteed bit rates. It supports extended bit rate values with optional fields.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for session management request rejection. Contains cause values defined in annex B of the specification.

entities.name: ESM information transfer flag
entities.description: Type 1 information element indicating whether security protected ESM information transfer is required. Bit 1 value determines the security requirement.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Type 1 information element identifying the default bearer associated with a dedicated EPS bearer or the EPS bearer with which packet filters are associated.

entities.name: Notification indicator
entities.description: Information element used to inform the UE about events relevant for upper layers, such as SRVCC handover cancellation and IMS session re-establishment requirement.

entities.name: PDN address
entities.description: Information element containing PDN type and address information, supporting IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, non-IP, and Ethernet address types with variable length.

entities.name: User data container
entities.description: Type 6 information element used to encapsulate user data transferred between UE and MME. Contains the actual user data payload.

entities.name: Release assistance indication
entities.description: Type 1 information element informing the network about expected data transmission patterns to assist with connection release decisions.

entities.name: Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate
entities.description: Information element providing extended APN-AMBR values with unit indicators supporting very high bit rates up to 256 Pbps.

entities.name: Extended quality of service
entities.description: Information element indicating maximum and guaranteed bit rates for EPS bearer contexts with values higher than 10 Gbps, supporting rates up to 256 Pbps.

entities.name: Security protected ESM information transfer required
entities.description: Condition determined by ESM information transfer flag value (bit 1) indicating whether security protection is required for ESM information transfer.

entities.name: Downlink data expected condition
entities.description: Condition indicated by release assistance indication specifying whether further uplink/downlink data transmission is expected after current transmission.

relations.description: ESM information transfer flag bit value determines whether security protected ESM information transfer is required
Release assistance indication DDX bits specify the expected data transmission pattern for connection release decisions
Extended APN-AMBR provides higher capacity version of APN-AMBR with extended bit rate ranges
Extended QoS provides higher capacity version of EPS QoS with extended bit rate ranges beyond 10 Gbps
User data container is carried within ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages for user data transfer between UE and MME
